en: A richly illustrated New Year postcard featuring a central niche with a classical female statue labeled "Hygieia" above a decorative fountain dated 1896. On the left is an interior with a tiled stove or bathhouse equipment, and on the right an industrial-looking room with basins and stacked trays, possibly related to hygiene or water facilities. The side panels are blue with floral ornaments and the top bears the name "ROB. HUBER". The New Year greeting is printed at the bottom in two languages, with city names given in two forms: "Helsingfors & Wiborg" and "Helsinki & Wiipuri".
